text:
anna.k: Cutoff in ~2h. Are we ready to tag and publish a GH draft? Need: annotated tag text, changelog bump, artifact owners for linux/amd64 + linux/arm64, and a checksum for each binary.

mike.r: I can take changelog + annotated tag message. Will post the snippet in a sec.

sara.l: Owning arm64 artifact upload. Will upload to the GH draft and S3 path once tag is pushed. ping @kevin for amd64 binary.

kevin: Out for a quick errand, back in ~30m. I can upload amd64 and create sha256 files then. If you need me to push tag I can do that too.

anna.k: Thanks. Suggested tag command to use (annotated):
```
git tag -a v1.12.0-rc.1 -m "v1.12.0-rc.1

- release: version bump to 1.12.0-rc.1
- fix(api): prevent double-alloc on KV cache refill
- perf(runtime): reduce mem copies for small batches

(see changelog for full details)"
```

mike.r: Changelog snippet (to include in tag message / GH release body):
"- Fix: handle edge-case tokenization bug when input contains unpaired surrogates.
- Perf: improved batching heuristics for short-sequence workloads (up to 12% CPU savings)."

sara.l: Uploaded arm64 binary to draft release (draft id: 4231). S3: s3://redwood-artifacts/v1.12.0-rc.1/linux-arm64/redwood-inference. Added mybinary-linux-arm64.sha256 to assets.

kevin: Pushed amd64 to draft as well and added sha256. Confirmed checksums: sha256sum outputs match.

release-bot: [release pipeline] staging smoke: PASSED :white_check_mark: (pipeline #1087)

anna.k: Great. Can someone confirm they pushed the annotated tag to origin? I want the GH draft to link to the tag and auto-populate commit diff.

kevin: I created the annotated tag locally and pushed: `git push origin refs/tags/v1.12.0-rc.1` :thumbsup:

mike.r: I copied the tag message into the GH draft body and published a draft notes blob. Leaving the release as Draft until QA signoff.

ci-bot: Automated check: release assets scanned for known CVEs — no critical findings.

sara.l: Quick note — arm64 binary size increased by ~1.3MB vs rc.0, but smoke runs fine on staging.

anna.k: OK. Plan: hold GH release Draft, cut the final release after one more canary tomorrow morning. For now this thread is enough for cutover docs. Thanks all.

mike.r: I'll add a follow-up PR to bump package.json + release notes links.

kevin: If nobody objects I'll mark the release milestone closed and move the board card.

sara.l: No objections from me. :shipit:

anna.k: Cool — resolving blockers. If anything else pops up, reply here. Otherwise we'll proceed with canary tomorrow.
